New Delhi Municipal Council, Palika Kendra, Sansad Marg, New Delhi-110002. ** ..Respondents** The Commission vide order dated 25.1.2021 had revised the transmission tariff of the 2001-04, 2004-09 and 2009-14 tariff periods and trued up the transmission tariff of the 2014-19 tariff period under the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2014 and determined the transmission tariff of the 2019-24 tariff period under Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 in respect of the following assets under “Transmission System associated with RAPP-B Project” in the Northern Region (hereinafter referred to as “the transmission project”): **Asset-c** : 220 kV S/C RAPP-B-Anta Transmission Line with associated Bays at Anta end. 2. It is noticed that certain inadvertent typographical errors have occurred in one of the tables under paragraph 21 in respect of Asset-a, and in calculation of the Interest on Loan allowed for the transmission assets for the 2001-04 period which has further impact on the other components of tariff of the 2001-04 period and the subsequent tariff periods. 3. These inadvertent errors are being rectified in exercise of powers under Regulation 103A of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 1999. 4.
